Customer-reported observations: broadband drops; Cable in my home is intact

Clarify: During a drop, does a device connected by Ethernet also lose internet, or is only Wi-Fi affected?

Clarify: Which provider and country or region should the support contact be for?

[S1] Ask an authorized agent to verify: Moving the affected PC to a known-good cable negotiates a gigabit link. Only if confirmed, the procedure proposes: Replace the damaged cable with a compatible tested cable.

[S1] Restriction: Do not change the subscription or blame the access network when another wired device performs normally.

[S2] Ask an authorized agent to verify: Authorized technician reproduces voltage drops with the ONT power adapter. Only if confirmed, the procedure proposes: Replace the adapter with the provider-approved matching unit.

[S2] Restriction: Do not suggest opening the adapter or using an incompatible supply.

[S3] Ask an authorized agent to verify: Gateway logs show session renewals failing against a stale lease record. Only if confirmed, the procedure proposes: Authorized access team clears the stale lease and applies the validated renewal configuration.

[S3] Restriction: Do not diagnose a broken optical cable without optical fault evidence.

No verified provider contact is available in this corpus; no helpline number is supplied.

The cited procedures are fictional-provider examples and require review before use with a real provider.
